sections.content: When 'like' has a specific, named object -- often with the definite article a/az -- the verb switches to the definite conjugation: szeretem, not szeretek. This is the same kérek/kérem contrast from Unit 21, also seen with viselek/viselem.

items.spanish: Szeretem az úszást és a futást.

sections.content: Test yourself: if you could put 'a/az' or 'this/that' in front of the English object, you need szeretem. If the object is just a general activity with no article, like 'sportolni', use szeretek.
